scope: independent actual generated-code review; CPU only, permits 8K/B32 performance screen, not precision or 128K qualification
integer_accumulation: K0 initializes INT32 then K256/K512/K768 each accumulate once; no atomic or GM accumulation reads. Absolute dot bound 1024*128^2=2^24 <2^31.
valid_rows: QR TLOAD and output TSTORE use min(T-t0,128); original dequant may read allocated invalid tile rows but no cross-row reduction and only valid row stores. Not all ceil128 scratch rows are initialized.
ring_method: 1024B alignment per actual tensor, all mutually exclusive branches and sibling scopes conservatively accumulated; default 256MiB per-depth only, not measured peak
dependencies: original QA -> qr_i8 -> q_i32 -> dequant same allocation/scope; generated MTE1/MTE2, M/MTE1 and FIX/M protections verified
